import random
random.seed(1303)

def _hoare(array, low, high):
    pivot = array[high]                      # the pivot is the last element
    a, b = low, high - 1
    while True:
        while a <= b and array[a] <= pivot:  # a stops on a value bigger than the pivot
            a += 1
        while a <= b and array[b] >= pivot:  # b stops on a value smaller than the pivot
            b -= 1
        if a < b:                            # both stopped: swap the two values
            array[a], array[b] = array[b], array[a]
        else:                                # the pointers have met or crossed
            break
    array[a], array[high] = array[high], array[a]   # pivot into its final place
    return a

cases = []
for _ in range(500):
    n = random.randint(1, 10)
    arr = [random.randint(-3, 3) for _ in range(n)]
    low = random.randint(0, n - 1)
    cases.append((arr, low, random.randint(low, n - 1)))
want = []
for arr, low, high in cases:
    x = arr[:]
    want.append((_hoare(x, low, high), x))
tests.setup:

for arr, low, high in cases:
    x = arr[:]
    got.append((partition(x, low, high), x))
